checkpoints.question: A cloud service provider's SLA guarantees 99.99% uptime. Approximately how much downtime per year does this permit?

options.A: Approximately 5 minutes of downtime per year
options.B: Approximately 52 minutes of downtime per year
options.C: Approximately 8.7 hours of downtime per year
options.D: Approximately 1 hour of downtime per year

checkpoints.explanation: The study guide table shows that 99.99% uptime permits approximately 52 minutes of downtime per year.

checkpoints.section: Memorandum of Understanding (MOU) vs. Memorandum of Agreement (MOA)
checkpoints.question: Your organization is starting an exploratory partnership with another company to evaluate potential collaboration. Which document type is most appropriate for this early-stage arrangement?

options.A: A Memorandum of Agreement committing both parties to specific deliverables
options.B: A Statement of Work documenting scope and timeline for the partnership
options.C: A Memorandum of Understanding expressing mutual intent without enforceable obligations
options.D: A Master Service Agreement covering ongoing billing and liability terms

checkpoints.explanation: The section states an MOU is non-binding and used for exploratory partnerships and early-stage collaborations before a formal contract exists.

checkpoints.section: Master Service Agreement (MSA) and Statement of Work (SOW)
checkpoints.question: Your organization signs an MSA with a consulting firm covering billing, liability, and security requirements for the relationship. A specific project then needs detailed scope, deliverables, and timeline documentation. What document should be created?

options.A: A second Master Service Agreement that addresses the specific project requirements and scope
options.B: A Non-Disclosure Agreement that protects confidential information related to the project
options.C: A Service Level Agreement that sets performance targets and metrics for the project
options.D: A Statement of Work that documents the scope, deliverables, and timeline of the project

checkpoints.explanation: The section explains that a SOW documents the specifics of one project within the MSA's framework, including scope, deliverables, timeline, and acceptance criteria.

checkpoints.question: When two companies are evaluating a potential merger and exchanging sensitive financial information, which type of NDA is most appropriate?

options.A: A bilateral NDA obligating both parties to maintain confidentiality
options.B: A mutual NDA requiring only initial confidentiality before contract signing
options.C: A unilateral NDA obligating only one party to maintain confidentiality
options.D: A multilateral NDA involving three or more parties in the arrangement

checkpoints.explanation: The section states that a bilateral NDA applies when both parties exchange sensitive information and both have confidentiality obligations, as in due diligence scenarios.

checkpoints.question: Your organization (the data controller) engages a cloud provider to process personal data of EU residents. Under GDPR Article 28, what must the DPA require the cloud provider to do regarding sub-processors it hires?

options.A: Document all sub-processors but make hiring and removal decisions independently
options.B: Keep sub-processor details confidential and notify the controller after the fact
options.C: Automatically remove any sub-processor your organization questions or disapproves of
options.D: Disclose all sub-processors and obtain controller approval before adding new ones

checkpoints.explanation: The section states the processor must disclose all sub-processors and get controller approval before adding new ones as a required DPA provision.

checkpoints.question: Your organization is establishing a direct network connection with a government agency. What is the primary purpose of the Interconnection Security Agreement for this link?

options.A: To define the scope of work and deliverables the agency expects from your organization
options.B: To set service availability targets and uptime guarantees for the network connection
options.C: To document security controls, protocols, and incident response details governing the direct connection
options.D: To establish confidentiality obligations for any information shared over the connection

checkpoints.explanation: The section states that an ISA documents the security controls and technical details governing a direct network connection, including protocols, data types, and incident response contacts.

checkpoints.question: You are contracting with a software vendor and want to ensure the vendor promptly notifies your organization if a security incident occurs. Which security-specific clause should be included in the contract?

options.A: An asset return clause defining how the vendor handles data destruction at contract end
options.B: A breach notification clause requiring the vendor to notify within a defined timeframe
options.C: A cyber liability insurance clause requiring the vendor to maintain specific coverage amounts
options.D: A data ownership clause confirming your organization retains ownership of created data

checkpoints.explanation: The section explicitly identifies the breach notification clause as setting the maximum time a vendor has to notify the organization after discovering a security incident.
